correctness.rationale: Renewal at a fixed reset point makes final-success mark/time law proportional to e^{-Dq^2t}f_x(t)S_y(t) and its swapped counterpart. Subtracting the unconstrained one-axis Laplace weight e^{-qx} gives positive corner deficit; Gaussian first-passage density plus exact Mills representation m(u)=int_0^infty exp(-w-w^2/(4u^2))dw supplies 0<=1-m<=1/(2u^2). Two positive Bessel integral identities yield the global K0/K1 inequality with exact constants. R_q=sqrt(2)a+O(q^-2) and K0 asymptotics give the sharp normalized corner coefficient, while the normalized inverse-Gaussian tilt has mean d/(2Dq), variance d/(4D^2q^3), and Gaussian characteristic-function limit; omitted-opposite-axis mass is exponentially small. This establishes the joint Bernoulli(logistic(z))-Gaussian limit for fixed a,D,z and the final *successful excursion* only.
